composition: Octagonal brick dome church and the unfinished square tower, moat around the churchyard · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Koepelkerk in Willemstad is an octagonal red-brick church with a dome and a low unfinished square tower, stone dressings around the windows, and a moat around the churchyard. It is overcast, about 13.3°C. A tall spire was never completed and is not shown. The church is closed.
